parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Filter only time entries that have a start date before (not including) the given date (example: 2021-12-31)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Filter only time entries that have a start date after (not including) the given date (example: 2021-12-31)

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter only time entries that are active (have no end date, are still running)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of returned time entries

parameters.name: only_full_dates
parameters.description: Filter makes sure that only time entries of a whole date are returned

user_id.description: ID of the user that the time entry should belong to

task_id.description: ID of the task that the time entry should belong to

start.description: Start of time entry (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone)

end.description: End of time entry (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone)

get.description: Returns a list of weeks (most recent first) with total tracked seconds per week, used for the timesheet accordion layout.
Returns rows grouped by project+task with 7 day columns. Each cell contains total hours and related time entry IDs.

put.description: Creates, updates, or deletes time entries for a given project+task+date cell. When hours > 0, creates or updates. When hours = 0, deletes all entries for that cell.

get.description: Returns recently used project+task combinations for the current user, ordered by most recently used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of recent tasks to return (1-50)

start.description: Start of time entry (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone, example: 2024-02-26T17:17:17Z)

end.description: End of time entry (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone, example: 2024-02-26T17:17:17Z)

duration.description: Duration of time entry in seconds

label.description: Human-readable week label (e.g., 'This Week', 'Last Week', 'Jan 06 - Jan 12, 2026')

total_seconds.description: Total tracked seconds in this week

time_entry_ids.description: IDs of time entries in this cell

cells.description: 7 cells, one per day of the week

total_hours.description: Sum of hours across all cells in this row

week_total.description: Sum of all hours in the week

project_id.description: ID of the project (null for no project)

task_id.description: ID of the task (null for no task)

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
